description: Adds one screenshot to a project (5 at most), from a public URL or, with the npx package, a local file. Each call adds another one: a repeated call adds the same image twice.

file_path.description: A local image inside SUBMITATOR_FILES_DIR (or the starting folder), instead of url

url.description: Public image URL: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, 5 MB at most

name: add_screenshot
title: Add a screenshot
